ingameEffects.label: Collision Potential (W-Engine Passive)
ingameEffects.description: When EX Special Attack hits an enemy, one of three possible effects is randomly triggered for 5 seconds. This effect can trigger once every 0.3s. the same types of effects cannot stack. Repeated triggers reset the duration, allowing several effects to be active at once: Increases the equipper's ATK, increases the equipper's Anomaly Proficiency, or increases the equipper's Anomaly Buildup Rate.
ingameEffects.shortDescription: Increases the equipper's ATK and/or Anomaly Proficiency.
